crossRefs.note: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.
Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.
Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.
mountains and all hills; fruit trees and all cedars;
wild animals and all livestock; small creatures and flying birds;
Sing, you heavens, for Yahweh has done it! Shout, you lower parts of the earth! Break out into singing, you mountains…

translations.web: Let the sea roar, and its fullness! Let the field exult, and all that is in it!
translations.bsb: Let the sea resound, and all that fills it; let the fields exult, and all that is in them.
translations.kjv: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that is therein.
translations.asv: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; Let the field exult, and all that is therein;
